scope: Experimental model-improvement phase. The production model was NOT retrained, NOT replaced and NOT modified.
final_decision: A - genuine improvement, scoped to the operating point; C - no improvement for the model itself

experiments.name: harness validation
experiments.result: reproduced published test and temporal PR-AUC with delta 0.00000

experiments.name: threshold optimisation
experiments.result: ACCEPT as candidate - t=0.35 gives test recall +0.10883 and temporal recall +0.13284 with PR-AUC unchanged

experiments.name: class weight
experiments.result: REJECT - PR-AUC flat across weights 0.75-3.0; validation winner was worse on test and temporal

experiments.name: hyperparameter search
experiments.result: REJECT - CV gain +0.00137 is inside one CV std (0.00522); worse on validation, test and temporal

experiments.name: feature engineering and selection
experiments.result: REJECT - the production 30 beat both a 44-feature and a 123-feature set on validation; leakage screen clean (max single-feature AUC 0.683)

experiments.name: temporal validation
experiments.result: only the threshold change improved temporal performance; both rejected arms were neutral-to-worse

experiments.name: calibration
experiments.result: KEEP isotonic - it halves ECE (0.006403 to 0.002875); its PR-AUC cost is a tie artefact from collapsing 142,215 probabilities to 301

application_recommendation: Break ranking ties in 08_RECOMMENDATION_ENGINE/antibiotic_ranking.py using the uncalibrated score as a secondary sort key. Isotonic calibration leaves only 301 distinct probabilities, so agents tie in the ranked list - observed in UAT Test Case C. Not implemented; application-level change.
